name: DELETE_TOPIC
description: Delete a Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) topic. Requires the admin key. This is irreversible — the topic will no longer accept messages and its data becomes inaccessible via the SDK.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Admin key signing via freeze + sign pattern
implicitBehaviors.details: If adminPrivateKey is provided, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith() then signed with the admin key. Otherwise the operator key signs automatically (operator must be the admin).

inputs.name: adminPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Admin key (only if different from operator key)

errorMap.details: The topic ID does not exist on this network.
The provided key is not the admin key for this topic.
Transaction signature is invalid. Check the admin key.
Not enough HBAR to cover the transaction fee.
